items.q: Yeah, I remember King Oliver. That's the time, I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades... I remember when, uh, Joe Oliver used to play at the Royal Garden...

ctx.x: No, that wasn't my father's horn, that was the horn I bought. I bought it myself, I bought it from the Duke and Music store. Oh yeah, at the Nile Street. Yeah, Duke and Music store. And, uh, so Kelly used to take me everywhere he used to go, you know. And so later on I got, got up around about 19, say about 19 years old. And, uh, uh, no not 19 years old, I was 21 and I made my own band. Uh, me, Sammy Penn, not Sammy Penn, Sammy, uh, uh, William on trombone. And we had another, uh, fellow by the name of Mooka.…
Oh, yeah. Where was that? Do you remember about that?

items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Yeah, I remember King Oliver. That's the time, I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades... I remember when, uh, Joe Oliver used to play at the Royal Garden

ctx.x: Do you remember, uh, Joe Oliver, King Oliver?

Yeah, I remember King Oliver. That's the time, I remember when he used to take Louis Armstrong on parades, during the First World War. Louis was in short pants then. And, uh, and I remember when, uh, Joe Oliver used to play at the Royal Garden, at it on Ramport Street. I remember the night he, he, he quit playing and he left here. They, they raided the place and they, a lot of people jumped up the window, a lot of them broke their legs and things.
Oh really, they broke, I heard about that raid, yeah.
